Byte-by-byte Description of file: out10970_layers_mrt_with_header.txt
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Bytes Format Units   Label   Explanations
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   1-  4 D4     ----    j       Spheroid index starting with 0 from the outside
   6- 17 F12.10 Rjup    rE      Fractional equatorial radius of spheroid (1)
  19- 30 F12.10 Rjup    rS      Fractional volumetric radius of spheroid, rS (2)
  32- 43 F12.10 Mjup    CMass   Cumulative mass, computed from inside out
  45- 59 F15.10 GPa     P       Pressure
  61- 72 F12.10 g/cm3   rho     Density of spheroid (3)
  74- 85 F12.10 g/cm3   rho(P)  Density corresponding to pressure P (4)
  87- 96 F10.4  K       T       Temperature
  98-105 F8.6   kb/el   S       Entropy (5)
 107-114 F8.6   ----    X       Mass fraction of hydrogen
 116-123 F8.6   ----    Y       Mass fraction of helium
 125-132 F8.6   ----    Y/(X+Y) Helium mass divided by that hydrogen and helium
 134-151 F8.6   ----    Z       Mass fraction of heavier elements, Z=1-X-Y.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Note (1): In units of Jupiter's equatorial radius, 71492 km.
Note (2): Defined such that 4/3*pi*rS^3 = spheroid volume.
Note (3): Two density values are given because of the discretization error in
          CMS. Use the first value to compare with other interior models.
Note (4): Combine this value with pressure to compare the equation of state
Note (5): In units of Boltzmann constant per electron, referenced for 
          a H:He-110:9 mixing ratio, no nuclear spin effects included.
